name: IT Helpdesk Knowledge Assistant
description: A retrieval-based assistant that answers employees' IT questions (VPN setup, password reset steps, printer configuration) from the company's approved IT knowledge base. It cannot execute any action on systems; it only returns instructions and links, and can open a ticket for a human technician.
documentation:
KNOWLEDGE SOURCE: 420 approved IT articles owned by the service desk, reviewed quarterly. Answers cite the article.
PERSONAL DATA: none requested; employee identity comes from SSO and is only used to open a ticket.
HOSTING: model and vector index hosted in-Kingdom under a signed DPA; vendor contractually cannot train on company data.
PERMISSIONS: read-only access to the knowledge base; no access to Active Directory, email or production systems.
OVERSIGHT: 'Talk to a technician' button on every answer; automatic handoff when retrieval confidence is low.
TESTING: evaluated on 300 real historical tickets (94% correct, 0 unsafe instructions); prompt-injection red-team completed.
MONITORING: weekly dashboard of thumbs-down answers reviewed by the service-desk lead.
LOGGING: all conversations logged 6 months for quality review.
DISCLOSURE: UI clearly states it is an AI assistant.
